Out-Of-Core construction of Sparse Voxel Octrees
Octree construction The good news is, once you have your voxel grid data in that order, building a Sparse Voxel Octree in an out-of-core way can be done with limited memory constraints: using a buffer of 8 x#octree_depth x #node_size bits.
